description: This file defines classes and methods for managing analytic default distributions, integrating with invoice lines, stock pickings, and sale order lines in an Odoo module related to account analytic defaults.

classes.name: account_analytic_default
classes.description: Model for managing analytic distribution defaults with methods for retrieving the best matching record based on criteria.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of invoice line to automatically assign analytic account based on product and partner.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extension of stock picking to determine analytic account for invoice creation based on move line and partner.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extension of sale order line to set analytic account on invoice line creation based on sale order partner.

methods.name: account_get
methods.description: Retrieve the most appropriate analytic default record based on product, partner, user, and date criteria.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Update invoice line with the analytic account when product changes.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Determine the analytic account for a stock picking move line.

methods.name: invoice_line_create
methods.description: Create invoice lines and assign analytic accounts based on sale order and product.
